"code": """"Measured LightGBM baseline for this tabular task."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pandas as pd
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier


def fit_predict(train_csv: str, test_rows: list[dict[str, str]]) -> list[float]:
    train = pd.read_csv(train_csv)
    y = train.pop("y").astype(int)
    
    # High-cardinality categorical features for target encoding
    target_encode_cols = ["native_country", "workclass", "occupation"]
    
    # Fill missing values with mode in training data first
    for col in train.columns:
        if train[col].isna().any():
            mode_val = train[col].mode()[0] if len(train[col].mode()) > 0 else ""
            train[col] = train[col].fillna(mode_val)
    
    # Compute target encoding from training data only (prevents leakage)
    encodings = {}
    for col in target_encode_cols:
        encodings[col] = train.groupby(col)[y].mean().to_dict()
    
    global_mean = y.mean()
    
    # Apply target encoding to training data
    for col in target_encode_cols:
        train[col] = train[col].map(encodings[col]).fillna(global_mean)
    
    # Prepare test data
    test = pd.DataFrame(test_rows)
    
    # Ensure correct column order
    test = test[train.columns]
    
    # Fill missing values with mode from training data
    for col in train.columns:
        if test[col].isna().any():
            mode_val = train[col].mode()[0] if len(train[col].mode()) > 0 else ""
            test[col] = test[col].fillna(mode_val)
        
        # Apply target encoding for specified columns
        if col in target_encode_cols:
            test[col] = test[col].map(encodings[col]).fillna(global_mean)
        # Convert numeric columns
        elif pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(train[col]):
            test[col] = pd.to_numeric(test[col], errors='coerce')
    
    # Fit LightGBM model
    model = LGBMClassifier(random_state=20261114, n_jobs=1, verbosity=-1)
    model.fit(train, y)
    
    # Predict probabilities
    return model.predict_proba(test)[:, 1].tolist()",
"notes": "Implemented LightGBM with target encoding for native_country, workclass, occupation. Target encoding computed from train data only (grouped mean of y per category), prevents data leakage. Missing values filled with mode from training set. Numeric columns preserved as-is, other categoricals handled by LightGBM natively."
